summary: Add gated residency host sample primitives with explicit sensor coverage

replay.detail: No claim writer, scheduler, projection or replay is enabled.

schema.detail: No database or claim registry changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes.

compatibility.detail: Linux memory measurements use MemAvailable and smaps_rollup private fields. macOS and unreadable sensors report absence. Held-silent age requires an explicitly caught-up projection input; the unavailable store adapter is intentionally not implemented.

downtime.detail: The default-off gate performs no filesystem reads; no daemon calls or timers are added.

manual.detail: No operator action; activation belongs to the atomic stop/wake cutover.

recovery.detail: No persistent state or rollback restriction is introduced.
